# explicaR — LLM-readable API reference
# https://github.com/CathalByrneGit/explicaR
#
# explicaR is an R DeepWiki: point at any R or Python project (or a GitHub URL)
# and get a browsable, searchable, LLM-annotated wiki — one page per source file,
# an interactive Mermaid dependency graph, a DuckDB-backed code index, a ragnar
# RAG store with unified BM25+VSS semantic search (v0.5), and a stdio MCP server
# for Claude Desktop / Claude Code.
# Three output tiers: static file:// HTML (Tier 1), WASM SQL browser (Tier 2),
# live httpuv server with chat (Tier 3). All processing is local.

## Quick start

```r
library(explicaR)
explicar("path/to/project")          # parse + graph + viewer in one call
```

## Core functions

### explicar_parse
```
explicar_parse(
  project_dir = ".",
  pattern     = NULL,                 # auto-derived from languages
  recursive   = FALSE,
  backend     = c("auto","treesitter","r"),
  languages   = "r"                   # also accepts "python"
) -> list(nodes, edges, verbs)
```
Parses R (and optionally Python) scripts. Returns:
- `nodes`: tibble(name, type, file, line, label, shape_info)
  - types: "script", "variable", "function", "source"
- `edges`: tibble(from, to, type)
  - types: "produces", "consumes", "calls", "reads", "writes", "depends"
- `verbs`: tibble(file, line, fn_name, input_var, output_var, args, pkg)
  - one row per dplyr/tidyr verb call found

### explicar_graph
```
explicar_graph(
  parse_result,
  direction = c("TD","LR","BT","RL"),
  max_label = 40L
) -> character(1)
```
Returns a Mermaid `flowchart` diagram as a plain string. Paste into GitHub,
Quarto, or Obsidian. Node shapes: scripts=rectangle, variables=rounded,
functions=hexagon, source files=cylinder. Dashed arrows for "calls" edges.

### generate_viewer
```
generate_viewer(
  parse_result,
  title       = "explicaR Pipeline",
  output_file = "explicar_viewer.html",
  snapshots   = NULL,
  direction   = "TD",
  open        = TRUE,
  quiet       = FALSE
) -> invisible(output_file)
```
Writes a self-contained HTML file embedding the Mermaid graph + verb
before/after panels. Requires internet for Mermaid CDN rendering.

### generate_wasm_viewer
```
generate_wasm_viewer(
  parse_result,
  title       = "explicaR — WASM Viewer",
  output_file = "explicar_wasm.html",
  direction   = "TD",
  open        = TRUE,
  quiet       = FALSE
) -> invisible(output_file)
```
Tier-2 viewer. Same layout as generate_viewer but embeds DuckDB-WASM for
interactive SQL queries over the code graph in-browser (no server needed).
Tables available: nodes, edges, verbs. Requires internet for DuckDB-WASM
and Mermaid CDN.

### explicar_config
```
explicar_config(project_dir = ".") -> list
```
Returns active file-filter config. Merges package defaults
(`inst/config/defaults.yml`) with per-project `.explicar/config.yml` if
present. Requires `yaml` package for config file reading; falls back to
hardcoded defaults otherwise.
Keys: exclude_dirs, exclude_extensions, max_file_size_kb, default_languages, max_depth.

### explicar_wiki_build
```
explicar_wiki_build(
  project_dir = ".",
  db_path     = NULL,            # default: .explicar/explicar.duckdb
  llm_chat    = NULL,            # ellmer::Chat | NULL (auto Ollama) | FALSE (fallback)
  model       = "llama3.2",
  ollama_url  = "http://localhost:11434",
  languages   = c("r", "python"),
  force       = FALSE,
  quiet       = FALSE
) -> invisible(n_pages)
```
Generates one markdown wiki page per source file using an LLM.
Stores results in the `wiki` DuckDB table. Change detection: files
with unchanged mtime are skipped. Fallback: roxygen blocks + parse graph.

### deep_research
```
deep_research(
  chat,                  # ellmer::Chat with retrieval tool registered
  question,              # research question
  max_iterations = 5L
) -> invisible(chat)
```
Multi-turn research loop. Plans, iterates (retrieving via ragnar tools),
then terminates when response starts with "CONCLUSION:".

### explicar_ingest
```
explicar_ingest(
  project_dir = ".",
  db_path     = NULL,
  include     = c("wiki", "source", "readme", "vignettes"),
  embed       = FALSE,
  embed_model = "nomic-embed-text",
  ollama_url  = "http://localhost:11434",
  force       = FALSE,
  quiet       = FALSE
) -> invisible(n_chunks)
```
Ingests wiki pages + docs into the ragnar RAG store (same DuckDB file).
Builds BM25 + optional VSS index. Requires ragnar package.

### serve_explicar_mcp
```
serve_explicar_mcp(
  project_dir = ".",
  db_path     = NULL
) -> invisible()  [blocks on stdin]
```
stdio MCP server (JSON-RPC 2.0, MCP 2024-11-05).
Tools: search_code, query_graph (SELECT SQL), get_wiki, list_files.
Add to claude_desktop_config.json under mcpServers.

### resolve_project
```
resolve_project(project_dir) -> character(1)
```
Normalises a local path or remote URL to a local directory.
Remote repos cloned to ~/.explicar/repos/<host>/<owner>/<repo>/.
Subsequent calls run git pull. Uses git2r (preferred) or system git.

### explicar_llms_txt
```
explicar_llms_txt(
  project_dir = ".",
  output_file = NULL,    # default: <project_dir>/llms.txt
  db_path     = NULL,
  quiet       = FALSE
) -> invisible(output_file)
```
Generates a machine-readable llms.txt for the analyzed project:
stats, file list, function index, key objects, wiki summaries, Mermaid graph.

### explicar_embed
```
explicar_embed(
  project_dir = ".",
  db_path     = NULL,
  model       = "nomic-embed-text",
  ollama_url  = "http://localhost:11434",
  include     = c("nodes", "wiki"),  # "nodes","wiki","source","readme","vignettes"
  batch_size  = 20L,
  force       = FALSE,
  quiet       = FALSE
) -> invisible(n_chunks)
```
v0.5 unified embedding entry point. Converts code-graph nodes to text descriptions
and inserts them into the ragnar VSS store at `.explicar/explicar.duckdb`.
Non-node include items delegate to `explicar_ingest(embed=TRUE)`.
Requires Ollama running with the specified embedding model.
After calling, `explicar_semantic_retrieve()` and the MCP `search_code` tool
use vector-similarity search automatically.

### explicar_semantic_retrieve
```
explicar_semantic_retrieve(
  query,
  project_dir = ".",
  top_k       = 10L,
  bm25_only   = FALSE
) -> tibble(origin, hash, text, source, url, page_title)
```
Hybrid BM25 + VSS search over the unified ragnar store. Falls back to BM25 when
no embeddings are present. Requires `ragnar` and the store built by
`explicar_embed()` / `explicar_ingest()`.

### view_explicar_db
```
view_explicar_db(
  project_dir = ".",
  db_path     = NULL,
  llm_chat    = NULL,   # ellmer::Chat | NULL (search only)
  top_k       = 10L,
  port        = 8080L,
  host        = "127.0.0.1",
  open        = TRUE
) -> invisible(server)
```
Tier-3 server (requires httpuv). Endpoints: GET /, POST /chat,
POST /search, GET /graph.json, GET /wiki.json. Blocks until Ctrl+C.
ragnar retrieval auto-wired to llm_chat when store exists.

### explicar
```
explicar(
  project_dir  = ".",
  output_file  = NULL,
  output_dir   = NULL,
  title        = "explicaR — <project>",
  pkg_name     = NULL,
  languages    = "r",
  snapshots    = NULL,
  llm          = FALSE,
  llm_chat     = NULL,
  enrich       = FALSE,
  llm_model    = "qwen2.5-coder:3b",
  embed        = NULL,
  embed_model  = "nomic-embed-text",
  ingest       = TRUE,
  direction    = "TD",
  open         = TRUE,
  db_extensions = FALSE
) -> invisible(output_file)
```
Main entry point. Orchestrates: parse → targets detection → shape
attachment → optional LLM wiki build → ragnar ingest → generate_viewer.
New params: languages, llm, llm_chat, embed, ingest, output_dir, pkg_name.

### attach_shapes
```
attach_shapes(parse_result, shapes) -> parse_result
```
Annotates variable nodes with "nrow × ncol" badges.
`shapes` is a named list of data frames (name matches node name).

## targets integration

```
explicar_mode(project_dir) -> "targets" | "instrumented"
targets_available(project_dir, store) -> logical
targets_network(project_dir, store, script, outdated) -> list(nodes, edges, manifest)
explicar_targets(project_dir, names, store) -> named list
shapes_from_targets(project_dir, store) -> named list of data frames
targets_manifest(project_dir, store) -> tibble
```
`targets_network()` reads `tar_network()` topology and `tar_manifest()`
descriptions. Works when `_targets/` cache exists. No re-execution required.

## LLM enrichment (local Ollama)

```
enrich_node_label(fn_name_or_body, model, ollama_url, max_words, timeout_s) -> character
enrich_parse_result(parse_result, model, ollama_url, quiet) -> parse_result
ollama_available(model, ollama_url) -> logical
ollama_models(ollama_url) -> character vector
```
Enriches undocumented function nodes with plain-English labels via a local
Ollama instance. Priority: roxygen @title > inline comments > LLM.

## DuckDB code-graph index

```
explicar_index_build(
  project_dir, pattern = "*.R", recursive = TRUE,
  embed = FALSE, embed_model, ollama_url, force = FALSE, quiet = FALSE
) -> invisible(index_path)

explicar_index_retrieve(
  query, project_dir, top_k = 10L, type = NULL,
  embed_model, ollama_url
) -> tibble(name, type, file, line, label, shape_info)

explicar_index_connect(project_dir, read_only = TRUE) -> DBI connection
```
Persistent index at `.explicar/index.duckdb`. Tables: nodes, edges, verbs,
file_mtimes, docs, doc_embeddings. Only re-parses changed files.

## Local doc indexing (DuckDB)

```
explicar_index_build_docs(
  project_dir, include = c("man","source","readme","vignettes"),
  embed = FALSE, embed_model, ollama_url, force = FALSE, quiet = FALSE
) -> invisible(n_chunks)

explicar_index_generate_wiki(
  project_dir, model = "llama3.2", ollama_url, include, force, quiet
) -> invisible(n_pages)
```
Extracts docs from Rd files, roxygen blocks, README, and vignettes.
Stores in the `docs` table. `generate_wiki` sends each file to Ollama
and writes a wiki page per source file + an architecture overview.

## ragnar BM25 + VSS doc store

```
explicar_ragnar_build(
  project_dir, include = c("man","source","readme","vignettes"),
  embed = TRUE, embed_model = "nomic-embed-text", ollama_url,
  target_size = 1000L, force = FALSE, quiet = FALSE
) -> invisible(store_path)

explicar_doc_retrieve(
  query, project_dir, n = 10L, bm25_only = FALSE
) -> tibble(origin, hash, text, source, url, page_title)

explicar_register_retrieve(chat, project_dir, store_description) -> chat
```
Requires `ragnar` package. Store at `.explicar/docs.ragnar.duckdb`.
Hybrid BM25 + vector-similarity search; degrades to BM25 when Ollama
is unavailable at build time.
`explicar_register_retrieve` wires the store as a retrieval tool into
an `ellmer::Chat` for conversational Q&A (requires `ellmer` too).

## Shape utilities

```
shape_badge(df) -> "nrow × ncol" | NA
shape_badges(list_of_dfs) -> named character vector
col_type_summary(df) -> "int(3) dbl(2) chr(1)"
shape_description(df) -> "980 × 8 | dbl(5) int(2) chr(1)"
```

## Data structures

### parse_result (returned by explicar_parse)
```
list(
  nodes = tibble(name, type, file, line, label, shape_info),
  edges = tibble(from, to, type),
  verbs = tibble(file, line, fn_name, input_var, output_var, args, pkg)
)
```

### node types
- "script"   — a .R or .py source file
- "variable" — a named R/Python object (LHS of assignment)
- "function" — a named function defined in the project
- "source"   — raw data file (CSV, xlsx, …) or Python import

### edge types
- "produces" — script/function → variable (LHS assignment)
- "consumes" — variable → script (variable read in another script)
- "calls"    — script → function (SYMBOL_FUNCTION_CALL)
- "reads"    — script → source file / Python module import
- "writes"   — script → output file
- "depends"  — targets: target → upstream target

## File layout (installed package)

```
R/
  parse.R              — dispatch layer (explicar_parse)
  parse_treesitter.R   — tree-sitter backend (R files)
  parse_treesitter.R   — tree-sitter backend (R files)
  parse_r_fallback.R   — getParseData() backend
  parse_sitting_duck.R — DuckDB sitting_duck stub (future Tier 1)
  parse_python.R       — Python parser (treesitter.python or regex)
  graph.R              — Mermaid flowchart generator
  generate_viewer.R    — HTML template filler
  shapes.R             — shape badge utilities
  targets.R            — targets cache + network integration
  enrich.R             — Ollama LLM enrichment
  report.R             — explicar() orchestrator
  site.R               — explicar_site_build() multi-page static site
  provenance.R         — provenance tracking helpers
  index.R              — DuckDB code-graph index
  index-docs.R         — local doc extraction + wiki generation
  index-ragnar.R       — ragnar BM25+VSS doc store
  embed.R              — v0.5 unified embeddings + semantic retrieval
inst/
  templates/viewer.html — self-contained HTML template
  llms.txt              — this file
```
